Ruth, I posted Gideon's draft in #strategic-pod for him, and I haven't saved anything to a mailbox.

I couldn't save it as a mail draft. My draft tool writes to the mailbox of the person I'm working for, which is you, so a draft from me would have landed in your drafts with Gideon's name on it. Gideon can paste the text into his own mailbox and send it himself. Nothing has gone to Mateo.

The draft covers the Hartford kiosk outage on 3 August (offline at 10:42, both lanes working at 11:07) and ticket INC-4821 for Mateo's status-page access. It has no finance figures, and I took the facts from the #inc-vtg-hartford thread.
